image_description: A close-up photograph of a handmade pendant necklace resting on a textured, light gray stone or fabric surface. The necklace features a twisted wire chain (copper or bronze tone) and a large, circular, flat pendant with a distressed green/teal patina finish. The center of the pendant displays an embroidered or raised relief design of a pink/magenta butterfly with detailed wing patterns. A silver-toned bail connects the pendant to the chain.
